mutations.contract_domain: Exact half-open interval overlap for supported cuboid adjacency and support-area consumers
mutations.reason: Replacing hi <= lo with hi < lo changes only equality. The original equality branch returns zero, while the changed equality path returns hi-lo, also exactly zero without overflow. All other comparisons and subtraction paths are unchanged, preserving every caller-visible overlap, adjacency and support-area result.

mutations.contract_domain: NewNormalizedRequest validation with the pinned go-measurement/v2 v2.0.1 Quantity.Dimension contract
mutations.reason: Replacing the first error OR with AND cannot admit a request: Quantity.Dimension delegates to Unit.Dimension, which returns Dimensionless on every error in the pinned dependency. LengthDimension and MassDimension are distinct from Dimensionless, so either individual error still triggers its unchanged dimension-mismatch predicate and returns ErrInvalidRequest before subsequent processing. Successful dimensions are unchanged.

mutations.contract_domain: Request construction memory accounting through the supported raw and normalized memory-estimate callers
mutations.reason: Replacing size > 0 with size >= 0 is equivalent for all supported callers of memoryEstimate.add: addString always supplies size 1, and both raw and normalized accounting supply only the positive constant sizes 16, 64 and 256. The two predicates therefore evaluate identically for every reachable call, preserving the overflow guard, retained-byte estimate and budget-exhaustion result. No zero-size helper contract is claimed.

mutations.contract_domain: Object closing tokens from the same Go 1.27.1 JSON decoder that supplied the opening token
mutations.reason: Replacing error OR mismatched closing token with AND is equivalent under supported validateStrict and recursive validateValue calls. The decoder tracks the object delimiter: Token returns the matching closing brace with nil error, or a nil token with a nonnil error. Both predicates therefore agree in either reachable case. Fabricated internal tokens or mismatched decoder state are not supported inputs.
